description: smoke_test.py numerical self-check: finite-difference du/dt vs exact jax.jvp, on a tiny model, across CPU-fp32 / GPU-TF32 / GPU-highest precision.
reconstruction_note: Values taken from the smoke_test.py stdout printed in the 2026-11-05 conversation.

files.smoke_results.json: best delta / relative error / delta sweep for each precision mode

metrics_columns.best_delta: delta that minimizes the finite-difference vs jvp relative error
metrics_columns.best_rel_err: relative L2 error of du/dt (FD vs jvp) at best_delta
metrics_columns.u_norm: L2 norm of u at the test point
metrics_columns.jvp_du_norm: L2 norm of the exact jvp du/dt at the test point
